# GiftPo

> GiftPo is a dedicated mobile application designed to help you track, organize, and cherish the sentimental value of every gift you send and receive. Build deeper, more meaningful connections through thoughtful gifting.

## Overview
GiftPo is a smart mobile application available for iOS and Android that focuses on the sentimental value of gifting rather than just the management of items. It allows users to log gift memories, photos, occasion dates, notes, and view relationship-based gifting histories.

## Core Features
- **Preserve Memories**: Record gifts received or sent with photos, occasions (birthdays, anniversaries, holidays), and personal notes.
- **Nurture Relationships**: Maintain a complete history of gifts with individual friends and loved ones.
- **Accept Gifts**: Seamlessly accept and organize gifts sent by your loved ones with a single tap.
- **Invite Friends & Wishlists**: Share wishlists and explore thoughtful gifting ideas together.

## Authentication & Privacy
- **Authentication**: Uses Google Sign-In (OAuth 2.0) requesting minimal non-sensitive scopes (`openid`, `profile`, `email`) for secure identity verification and profile sync.
- **Privacy & Security**: Zero access to Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, or Contacts. Adheres strictly to the Google API Services User Data Policy (including Limited Use). Personal data is never sold to third parties or advertisers.
